market_question: Will another country leave OPEC in 2026?
reasoning: Only one OPEC member has withdrawn in any prior year (Qatar 2019, Ecuador 2020, Angola 2023). A second exit in the same year, triggered by UAE’s departure, would be historically unprecedented and lacks clear catalysts. The remaining time in 2026 is limited, and no other member has publicly signaled intent.
evidence_points: Historical OPEC exit pattern: one per year at most (Qatar 2019, Ecuador 2020, Angola 2023)
No credible signals from other members in April 2026 despite UAE's exit
Limited window (∼8 months) reduces probability of a complex political decision occurring and being announced
sources_consulted: Reuters article on UAE's OPEC exit (provided in market description)
